correctness.rationale: Complete constructive proof: the 5 Cayley generators give SRG(16,5,0,2), binary adjacency-pattern counting excludes all four-sets with internal edges, and the star/triangle classification of 3 intersecting two-subsets of 5 labels shows exactly 80 resolving star sets. Each four-star is a neighborhood minus one vertex and resolves via ten distinct common-neighbor pairs. Unique centers and neighborhood intersection at most 2 yield 16 disjoint K5 exchange components and exactly 160 edges; neighborhood independence makes all 160 original slides impossible and all 160 complementary slides possible. The complement has the same resolving sets because distances 1 and 2 are swapped outside the landmarks. Both standalone scripts checked all 1,820 four-sets and the full transition relation, with no sample-to-infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: A natural complete optimal-landmark placement classification for the canonical Clebsch folded cube, with a sharp, fully quantified obstruction to optimum-preserving relocation. Its original/complement pair preserves all minimum bases and unrestricted exchange moves while switching from 80 completely frozen local states to sixteen 5-clique mobile components. That contrast is a meaningful boundary case for local network landmark relocation, beyond a known single metric-dimension value, and the proof explains the mechanism rather than relying on an unmotivated isolated count.
